_doku: Detection and reporting; no merging, exclusion, score, name or membership change. Since 2026-10-18 (brief sd-dup, master decision) homeListingProposal decides the rank in the findash export: every other ticker of the issuer gets rank null with rankGrund dupIssuer when the home ticker stands in the same ranking (row and data stay); alone it keeps its rank; an open (null) proposal changes nothing. markFollowsHomeListing (master decision 2026-10-18) puts the marker of Copel and AXIA on the non-home listing (ELPC, AXIA); Kloeckner keeps its marker on the home row KCO.DE (not exported on 2026-10-17; the general rule would mark and hide its only exported row KCO.VI), own decision.
Erkennung und Meldung sind erlaubt; jede Verschmelzungs-Entscheidung auf Basis dieser Erkennung bleibt bis zu einem eigenen Gericht gesperrt.
Entries are reports, never merge decisions; this is separate from the empty identity register (M16, M18, M19).

codeKeeps records R11's re-enactment of the current production selection rule, not a decision about the true primary listing. Every other listed ticker is marked, even when codeKeeps is absent from the board.
homeListingProposal is R11 information only; it moves the flag only where markFollowsHomeListing is true; unresolved proposals are null.
Sources and verbatim quotes are supplied by R11-FINAL (2026-09-30); no network re-check was performed in this task.

2026-10-23 (numbers-trust audit 23.10.): circle, strategy, energy-fuels, star-bulk, vinci and the GE leg 1GE.MI were added with sources fetched and quotes checked verbatim on 2026-10-23; vinci's home listing DG.PA is excluded by production, so its legs DG.SW and DG.VI keep their ranks until DG.PA stands in the ranking.

2026-10-24 (numbers-trust audit 23.10.): skydance added with sources fetched and quotes checked verbatim on 2026-10-24; PSKY is the former Nasdaq ticker of the same Class B common stock (listing transferred to the NYSE as SKYD on 2026-10-06), so it is a stale leg of SKYD, not a second class.

2026-10-30 (P290, two reviews, sources re-read): Amrize gets the home listing AMRZ.SW with markFollowsHomeListing, so AMRZ holds no rank when both legs stand in a ranking. Three cases stay out on purpose: Aeromexico (the sources name AERO.MX, but its vendor series would put a wrong 52-week distance and a flat price step on the visible row, see its note); Siltronic and the Madrid leg XAXIA.MC of AXIA (the home legs WAF.DE and AXIA3.SA lose the sealed production dedup in src/scoring/score.js before the export, so this table can neither show them nor remove a rank without hiding the firm).
RBI (QSR / QSP.TO) and Molson Coors (TAP-A / TPX.TO) are deliberately absent: economically equivalent exchangeable shares, not secondary listings; TPX.TO class attribution is unproven.

amrize.note: A decision for a true dual listing, not a claim that the NYSE line is secondary. The quote is the Amrize Ltd row (ISIN CH1430134226) of the SIX issuer list behind the column "Primary Listing*" on https://www.six-group.com/en/market-data/shares/companies.html, read 2026-10-30; 10 of the 241 issuers there carry false (3M, Abbott, Pepsico), so the SIX line is not a secondary listing. Tie-break: the listing in the country of the registered office; the 10-K for 2025 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2035989/000203598926000017/holcim-20251231.htm) gives "Our principal executive offices are located at Grafenauweg 8, 6300 Zug, Switzerland" and "We also have operational headquarters in Chicago." No filing names a primary or a secondary listing: the 10-K says "listed under the symbol “AMRZ” on the New York Stock Exchange and the SIX Swiss Exchange". Strongest counter-evidence: the 8-K of June 2025 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2035989/000114036125023352/ef20050735_8k.htm) has "to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange, with an additional listing on the SIX Swiss Exchange". A company document naming a primary listing flips this entry. Earlier source of this row, not re-read: https://investors.amrize.com/resources/faq (both lines trade under AMRZ).
